[TEST] Transvaginal and transabdominal pelvic ultrasound
Not specified

With severe anemia (Hb 7.5 g/dL), normocytic indices, high reticulocytes, and no red-flag symptoms — but persistent lower abdominal pain and fatigue — the most parsimonious explanation that fits *all* data is **autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA)**. Further testing (e.g., direct Coombs test) would confirm, but per task constraints, I must now commit to the single most likely diagnosis.

[DIAGNOSIS] Autoimmune hemolytic anemia
